name: ReferenceCandidateMatching

steps: replace each maximal run of Unicode whitespace characters (str.isspace()) including surrounding whitespace with one ASCII U+0020 space, then remove leading/trailing separator
do not strip or rewrite punctuation
normalizer.determinism: same Python Unicode database/runtime line must produce governed golden-vector results; Python 3.13 and 3.14 CI must both pass the same accepted vector corpus before release

customer_org_match.rule: UNIQUE_CANDIDATE remains candidate evidence and does not by itself authorize merge/reassignment

contact_match.scope: exactly one of customer_org_id or UNBOUND
contact_match.email_key: active contact_channels where channel_kind='email' using match_key
contact_match.customer_scope_query: candidate Contact must have is_current=1 affiliation to the supplied customer_org_id
contact_match.unbound_scope_query: candidate Contact must have no is_current=1 affiliation row
contact_match.candidate_union: union candidate IDs from supplied governed keys; repeated evidence for the same Contact collapses to one candidate ID
contact_match.rule: equal normalized email in different Customer scopes is not a global identity collision; equal keys within one scope may remain ambiguous

write_time_key_rule: Every accepted write that changes a matched descriptive/channel value computes the match key with this same function inside application validation before persistence; repositories reject missing/inconsistent derived key input.
review_rule: A matcher has no write capability. Selection/link/merge/reassignment is performed only by a separate owning command after operator/reconciliation authority and fresh state revalidation.
